editorial:
Imagine you are broke and see a weird ad online offering a thousand bucks for one day of filming. That is exactly how you enter the world of this movie. You follow Aaron, a nice guy who just wants a paycheck, as he drives to a lonely cabin to film a man named Josef. At first, everything feels a bit off, but not dangerous. Josef seems like a lonely guy who just wants to leave a video for his future son. The vibe is awkward and strange, making you feel like something is wrong even when everything seems fine on the surface.

What really makes this work is the acting. Josef is creepy in a way that feels way too real, and you will find yourself leaning in just to see if he is joking or actually crazy. The pacing is slow at first, but it builds up to a point where you cannot look away. If you love movies that mess with your head, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: You find out that Josef has been doing this for a long time. He lures people to the cabin, records them, and then kills them. He captures the exact moment they realize they are going to die. In the end, Josef traps Aaron and kills him. The movie ends with Josef filming himself, showing that he has now moved on to his next target, continuing his sick cycle of games.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological thrillers and found-footage movies.
